name: frostbyte
description: FrostByte — an agentic workspace, model manager, and peer-to-peer model network.
author: Blackfrost_AI

scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:managers && npm run test:reliability && npm run test:catalog-import && npm run test:path-capabilities && npm run test:hf-options && npm run test:hf && npm run test:discovery && npm run test:spark && npm run test:assistant && npm run test:privacy && npm run test:hybrid && npm run test:hub && npm run test:release && npm run test:ipfs && npm run test:integrity && npm run test:cli
scripts.test:hf-options: node --test tests/hf-options.test.js tests/hf-formats.test.js tests/markdown.test.js tests/card-images.test.js tests/hf-variants.test.js tests/serve-recipes.test.js tests/theme-credits.test.js tests/release-tracking.test.js
scripts.test:reliability: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/reliability.test.js tests/inventory.test.js tests/model-library.test.js tests/item-sharing.test.js tests/transfer-removal.test.js tests/transfer-intent.test.js tests/shutdown.test.js tests/network-status.test.js
scripts.pack:mac: node scripts/build-ipfs-runtime.js darwin-arm64 && node scripts/build-llama-runtime.js darwin-arm64 && npm run build:licenses && npm run build:icon && npm run build:spark && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/build-ipfs-runtime.js darwin-arm64 && node scripts/build-llama-runtime.js darwin-arm64 && npm run build:licenses && npm run build:icon && npm run build:spark && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:signed: node -e "require('./build/signing-macos.cjs')()" && node scripts/build-ipfs-runtime.js darwin-arm64 && node scripts/build-llama-runtime.js darwin-arm64 && npm run build:licenses && npm run build:icon && npm run build:spark && electron-builder --config build/signing-macos.cjs --mac --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/notarize-macos-dmg.mjs
scripts.pack:win: node scripts/build-ipfs-runtime.js win32-x64 && npm run build:licenses && npm run build:icon && npm run build:spark && node scripts/build-windows.js --dir
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/build-ipfs-runtime.js win32-x64 && npm run build:licenses && npm run build:icon && npm run build:spark && node scripts/build-windows.js
scripts.pack:linux: node scripts/build-ipfs-runtime.js linux-x64 && npm run build:licenses && npm run build:icon && npm run build:spark && electron-builder --linux --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/build-ipfs-runtime.js linux-x64 && npm run build:licenses && npm run build:icon && npm run build:spark && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
